+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from enum import Enum
+from typing import Any, Dict, Mapping, MutableMapping, Optional
+
+
+class SafetyLabel(str, Enum):
+    SAFE = "safe"
+    UNSAFE = "unsafe"
+    UNKNOWN = "unknown"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TextSafetyRequest:
+    text: str
+    language: Optional[str] = None
+    categories: tuple[str, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
+
+    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        data: Dict[str, Any] = {"text": self.text}
+        if self.language is not None:
+            data["language"] = self.language
+        if self.categories:
+            data["categories"] = list(self.categories)
+        return data
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class SafetyCategoryScore:
+    category: str
+    score: float
+    flagged: bool = False
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_mapping(cls, data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> "SafetyCategoryScore":
+        return cls(
+            category=str(data.get("category", "")),
+            score=float(data.get("score", 0.0)),
+            flagged=bool(data.get("flagged", False)),
+        )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TextSafetyResponse:
+    label: SafetyLabel
+    confidence: float
+    categories: tuple[SafetyCategoryScore, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
+    raw: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    @property
+    def is_safe(self) -> bool:
+        return self.label == SafetyLabel.SAFE
+
+
+def _coerce_label(value: Any) -> SafetyLabel:
+    if isinstance(value, SafetyLabel):
+        return value
+    if value is None:
+        return SafetyLabel.UNKNOWN
+    normalized = str(value).strip().lower()
+    if normalized in {SafetyLabel.SAFE.value, "clean", "ok"}:
+        return SafetyLabel.SAFE
+    if normalized in {SafetyLabel.UNSAFE.value, "unsafe_content", "flagged"}:
+        return SafetyLabel.UNSAFE
+    return SafetyLabel.UNKNOWN
+
+
+def normalize_text_safety_response(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> TextSafetyResponse:
+    label_value = payload.get("label", payload.get("safety_label", payload.get("verdict")))
+    confidence_value = payload.get("confidence", payload.get("score", 0.0))
+
+    categories_payload = payload.get("categories", payload.get("category_scores", []))
+    categories: list[SafetyCategoryScore] = []
+    if isinstance(categories_payload, list):
+        for item in categories_payload:
+            if isinstance(item, Mapping):
+                categories.append(SafetyCategoryScore.from_mapping(item))
+
+    raw: Dict[str, Any] = dict(payload)
+    return TextSafetyResponse(
+        label=_coerce_label(label_value),
+        confidence=float(confidence_value or 0.0),
+        categories=tuple(categories),
+        raw=raw,
+    )
+
+
+def normalize_text_safety_request(data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> TextSafetyRequest:
+    text = str(data.get("text", ""))
+    language = data.get("language")
+    categories_value = data.get("categories", ())
+    categories: tuple[str, ...]
+    if isinstance(categories_value, (list, tuple)):
+        categories = tuple(str(item) for item in categories_value)
+    else:
+        categories = ()
+    return TextSafetyRequest(text=text, language=None if language is None else str(language), categories=categories)
+
+
+def response_to_mapping(response: TextSafetyResponse) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "label": response.label.value,
+        "confidence": response.confidence,
+        "categories": [
+            {"category": item.category, "score": item.score, "flagged": item.flagged}
+            for item in response.categories
+        ],
+    }
+
*** End Patch

+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class SafetyConfig:
+    api_key: str
+    base_url: str = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
+    model: str = "text-moderation-latest"
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_env(cls) -> "SafetyConfig":
+        api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "").strip()
+        if not api_key:
+            raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+        base_url = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_BASE", cls.base_url).rstrip("/")
+        model = os.getenv("OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL", cls.model).strip() or cls.model
+        return cls(api_key=api_key, base_url=base_url, model=model)
+
+
+class TextContentSafetyClient:
+    def __init__(self, config: Optional[SafetyConfig] = None) -> None:
+        self.config = config or SafetyConfig.from_env()
+        self._session = requests.Session()
+        self._session.headers.update(
+            {
+                "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.config.api_key}",
+                "Content-Type": "application/json",
+            }
+        )
+
+    def moderate(self, text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        if not isinstance(text, str):
+            raise TypeError("text must be a string")
+        response = self._session.post(
+            f"{self.config.base_url}/moderations",
+            json={"model": self.config.model, "input": text},
+            timeout=30,
+        )
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        return response.json()
+
+    def is_safe(self, text: str) -> bool:
+        result = self.moderate(text)
+        outputs = result.get("results", [])
+        if not outputs:
+            return True
+        return not bool(outputs[0].get("flagged", False))
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        self._session.close()
+
+
+def load_safety_client() -> TextContentSafetyClient:
+    return TextContentSafetyClient()

+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Mapping, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_MODERATION_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "omni-moderation-latest"
+
+
+DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS: Dict[str, float] = {
+    "harassment": 0.5,
+    "hate": 0.5,
+    "self-harm": 0.5,
+    "sexual": 0.5,
+    "violence": 0.5,
+}
+
+
+class SafetyThresholdError(RuntimeError):
+    pass
+
+
+def _normalize_scores(result: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, float]:
+    scores: Dict[str, float] = {}
+    categories = result.get("category_scores") or {}
+    if isinstance(categories, Mapping):
+        for key, value in categories.items():
+            try:
+                scores[str(key)] = float(value)
+            except (TypeError, ValueError):
+                continue
+    return scores
+
+
+def _map_provider_categories(scores: Mapping[str, float]) -> Dict[str, float]:
+    mapped: Dict[str, float] = {}
+    for key, value in scores.items():
+        normalized = key.lower().replace("_", "-")
+        if "harass" in normalized:
+            mapped["harassment"] = max(mapped.get("harassment", 0.0), value)
+        elif "hate" in normalized:
+            mapped["hate"] = max(mapped.get("hate", 0.0), value)
+        elif "self-harm" in normalized or "selfharm" in normalized:
+            mapped["self-harm"] = max(mapped.get("self-harm", 0.0), value)
+        elif "sexual" in normalized:
+            mapped["sexual"] = max(mapped.get("sexual", 0.0), value)
+        elif "violence" in normalized or "violent" in normalized:
+            mapped["violence"] = max(mapped.get("violence", 0.0), value)
+    return mapped
+
+
+def evaluate_text(text: str, thresholds: Optional[Mapping[str, float]] = None, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    if not text:
+        return {"allow": True, "reason": "empty_text", "scores": {}, "thresholds": dict(thresholds or DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS)}
+
+    key = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise SafetyThresholdError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_MODERATION_URL,
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        json={"model": OPENAI_MODEL, "input": text},
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    if response.status_code >= 400:
+        raise SafetyThresholdError(f"OpenAI moderation request failed: {response.status_code} {response.text}")
+
+    payload = response.json()
+    results = payload.get("results") or []
+    if not results:
+        raise SafetyThresholdError("OpenAI moderation response missing results")
+
+    item = results[0] if isinstance(results, list) else {}
+    scores = _map_provider_categories(_normalize_scores(item))
